usefulness.rationale: The dossier body is empty; only identity anchors (Brazilian engineer, Qualcomm CEO since June 2021, UNICAMP graduate) and one retained Wikipedia source exist. A reader learns only the barest identity, with no career detail, achievements, or context. Because the dossier makes no substantive claims, it cannot be said to imply completeness, but it also never states what is unknown. The two listed unjustified conclusions (invented-5g, current-pay) have no matching statements in the dossier, so no overclaims can be matched to cited passages. Conversation readiness is minimal: a reader knows who Amon is and his current role but nothing to prepare discussion content from.
